# arcblog.localhost

## For agents

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://arcblog.localhost/mcp
- Server card: https://arcblog.localhost/.well-known/mcp.json
- AFS over HTTP (JSON-RPC): POST https://arcblog.localhost/api/afs/rpc
- Generic AFS public read; writes require DID-Connect auth

Locales: en, zh (base: en). A locale listed on an item below is a real translation; any other locale serves the base-language text as fallback.

Full-text version (all collections, never truncated): https://arcblog.localhost/llms-full.txt
